scope: Fresh live 474-record mechanics frontier excluding skill IDs represented by registered current-evidence audits; eight shortest remaining under-detailed records were enriched.

selected.name: Fierce Fist
selected.finding: Current skill-specific evidence confirms a 100-Ki three-stage chargeable Strike Super from PQ159; Stage 3 is unblockable, charge can be preserved while guarding, weak Ki Blasts are negated during the attack, and source-reported displayed damage is about 10%/15%/20%.
selected.change: Expanded canonical mechanics notes with charge stages, defensive interaction, and bounded damage values.

selected.name: Venus Fist
selected.finding: Current 2026 evidence confirms the final-DLC PQ186 acquisition endpoint and a multi-step rush/teleport Strike Ultimate; recent community/video evidence documents low-Health behavior and describes a 3-Ki-bar cost, but exact hit/scaling details remain unresolved.
selected.change: Expanded mechanics boundary without promoting unsupported exact hit or scaling data.

selected.name: Handy Canon
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms a 100-Ki PQ115 Ki Blast Super that fires a fast scattering barrage and can be step-cancelled into approach/basic follow-ups.
selected.change: Expanded canonical mechanics and combo/neutral utility.

selected.name: Full Power Destruction
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms a 500-Ki PQ177 Ki Blast Ultimate with five tracking opener shots, a follow-up multi-hit blast, and cinematic explosion; the long full sequence can be Evasived.

selected.name: Prominence Flash
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms a 300-Ki chargeable Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ137; repeated activation increases damage with maintained community evidence indicating a third-use cap, while historical timing/scaling remains bounded.
selected.change: Expanded repeated-use behavior while preserving reward and version uncertainty.

selected.name: Galick Gun
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms a 100-Ki three-stage chargeable beam with 9/12/15 ideal hit outcomes and shorter charge time than Kamehameha; historical damage remains setup-specific.
selected.change: Expanded charge/hit behavior and Super Saiyan repositioning interaction.

selected.name: Ill Rain
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms a 100-Ki PQ64 Basic Reward that throws a lingering Ki ball and scatters three tracking projectiles, each documented at about 15% source-reported damage.
selected.change: Expanded projectile sequence and bounded damage behavior.

selected.name: Gigantic Cross
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms a 100-Ki chargeable 2-hit mouth-generated Ki Blast Super from Conton City Patrol 04; the projectile arcs upward and ends in an explosion.
selected.change: Expanded trajectory, charge, and hit-structure mechanics.

sources_policy: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence prioritized. Source-reported numerical values remain source-bound; unsupported frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and drop probabilities are not inferred.
canonical_sync: All eight selected records synchronized into docs/data/skills.json and docs/data/skills-index.json.
